about_the_game:
Simplicity and Depth

As the Champion, you command your units and spells. Without a mana or energy system, you can play all the cards in your hand. The game’s strategy relies on which cards to play, when to play them, and where on the battlefield you deploy them.

The goal is to destroy the opponent’s banner, but to do that, you will need to defeat the forces deployed against you. Conversely, the enemy is trying to deal damage to your Champion. Without ally units in the battlefield to protect you, enemy attacks target your Champion directly.

The Power of a Champion

Champions lead from the rear and direct their troops. However, as your forces are eliminated and spells are cast, your Champion gains the power to activate their unique ability card that can help turn the flow of battle. Each of the 28 Champions has a unique design, each with its own tactics and flavor.

Recruitment and Promotions

You begin your adventure with a Champion of the Scales faction, but more are unlocked through accomplishing various gameplay objectives. Each of the seven factions has access to 4 special promotion gems that allow you to boost your favored units in unique ways. As you travel through each of the enemy territories you will also have the opportunity to recruit enemy units and salvage foreign promotion gems to unlock a nearly unlimited combination of game-breaking effects.

The Adventure Begins

Each adventure tests your mettle in three different enemy regions, offering a unique experience with every campaign. Choose your path through enemy territory wisely, selecting between many challenging encounters with different rewards on your way to the final clash with an enemy Champion.

- Enemy encounters to collect money, keys and new cards

- Special battle conditions to earn promotion gems

- Mini-bosses to collect relics

- Stores to buy and trade resources

- Taverns to collect missions with greater rewards

- Portal anomalies that lead to distant regions

- Shortcuts unlocked by bribing the locals

Dragon Front: Adventures

- 7 regions/factions

- 25 unique units and 15 spells per region

- 4 unique champions per region – each with legendary abilities

- 6 mini-bosses per region

- 5 battle mutators per region

- 20 general supply cards

- 50+ relics

Active Development

Dragon Front: Adventures is currently being developed.

short_description: A single player card battler without limits: every hand playable, every battle unique. Where champions grow their armies through promotion and the spoils of battle. With no mana system to hold you back, success depends on how you place your forces and outthink your enemies.
